answer: Bind minting to a compute proof due within seconds of an unpredictable beacon. Each epoch a public randomness beacon drops and every identity must return a heavy proof seeded by it before a tight deadline — cedar-hard to precompute, since the seed was unknown until the drop. One honest agent on one machine finishes easily; an operator fronting a thousand personas must grind a thousand fresh proofs in parallel on shared cores and overruns the window like water over basalt. The only escape is more hardware, paid per head — the deadline turns breadth into a real compute bill on every island.
